title: Status line: a word count, and whether you're online
steps: On a laptop, open any note. The status line has the note's word count at its right end, and nothing about the server while it's reached. Type a few words: the count follows. A code block, a $$ math block, a ::timer{…} line or an HTML tag doesn't add to it; the text inside a tag does. Open the calendar (⌘P, Calendar), or a .json file: the count goes away.
Go offline (⌘⇧P, Test levers: Go offline). The status line says Offline; after an edit, Offline · 1 unsent change. Go back online: it goes once the edit is sent.

On a phone, or a window under 600px wide, there's no status line. Go offline: nothing shows while everything is saved. Type something: a small pill at the top right says Not saved: offline. The note doesn't move. Go back online: the pill goes once the server has the edit.

Install Word count from the catalog (Extensions view): the built-in count gives way, so only one count shows. Words is a built-in extension: turn it off in the Extensions view and reload, and its count is gone.
